request.objective: Start at https://www.flightaware.com/. Find discussions of the community and open the one with the most replies of all time on Flightaware.

response.result:
The most-replied discussion of all time on FlightAware Discussions is **"The Banter Thread"**, and it is open at https://discussions.flightaware.com/t/the-banter-thread/4412 — category FlightAware › General.

How it surfaced: from the FlightAware site I went into the community forum (discussions.flightaware.com), opened the **Top** page, set the period to **All time** and sorted by **Replies**. The Banter Thread came out on top with **5.5k replies** and 2.4M views, ahead of:
- "HOWTO: Airspy mini and Airspy R2: Piaware / dump1090-fa configuration" — 4.6k replies, 116k views
- "ADS-B Receiver Project Setup Scripts" — 1.9k replies, 364k views
- "Nascar Airplanes" — 1.7k replies, 1.0M views

The thread itself was started on 27 December 2007 by mduell, a FlightAware staff member, as a place for the regulars' off-topic banter. Its post counter runs to 5,519 posts.
